answer: Anchor each identity to the drift of its own quartz oscillator: every machine crystal ticks slightly off, a fingerprint no software clone can fake. At registration the agent docks at the network jetty and streams timing samples for a full epoch, slowly building a terrace of trust one verified sample at a time. Identities sharing one drift signature are merged into a single payout, and a farm of clones on one host collapses to one account. Renting genuinely distinct hardware per clone costs far more than the reward, so Sybils price themselves out.
